title: General Trade Knowledge & Theory — Extended
description: Electrical theory, Ohm's Law, AC/DC fundamentals, transformers, test equipment, trade math, data cabling, fiber optics, and safety for the WA Telecom Administrator exam. 30 questions.

title: NEC Article 250 — Grounding & Bonding
description: System grounding, equipment grounding, grounding electrodes, bonding, and grounding electrode conductors per NEC 2023 Article 250. 30 questions.

title: NEC Articles 300–398 — Wiring Methods
description: General wiring methods, conductor installation, boxes, raceways, cables, and related requirements per NEC 2023 Articles 300–398. 29 questions.

title: NEC 2023 Articles 500–516 — Hazardous Locations Practice Test
description: A 30-question practice test drawn from the text and tables of NEC 70, 2023 edition, covering hazardous-location documentation and classification, material groups, equipment marking, wiring methods, seals, bonding, intrinsically safe systems, gas and dust zones, commercial garages, motor-fuel dispensing facilities, and spray applications.

title: NEC 2023 Articles 705–770 — Special Conditions
description: Thirty book-reference questions drawn only from NEC 2023 Articles 705, 706, 708, 710, 722, 724, 725, 726, 728, 750, 760, and 770. Question stems omit section-number clues; answers are stated in the cited NEC text or tables.

title: NEC 2023 Chapter 8 — Communications Systems Practice Test
description: A 30-question telecommunications administrator practice test drawn from the text and tables of NEC 70, 2023 edition, covering general communications requirements, communications circuits, antenna systems, CATV systems, and network-powered broadband systems.

title: NEC 2023 Articles 90–110 — Introduction, Definitions, and General Requirements
description: A 30-question practice test drawn from NEC 70, 2023 edition. The quiz follows the official 2-to-3 weighting with 12 questions on the Introduction and 18 questions on definitions and general electrical-installation requirements.

title: NEC 2023 + General Theory — Mixed Set 02
description: Questions 29–60 from study session: NEC Articles 110, 230, 250, 310.15, 314, 334, 408, 500, 501, and general trade theory (Ohm's Law, AC/DC, fiber optic, data cabling, PoE).

title: WA Telecom Admin — Pretest A
description: 30-question NEC 2023 book-reference pretest. Distribution: Introduction 2; General Requirements 3; Grounding and Bonding 3; Wiring Methods 3; Hazardous Locations 1; Special Conditions 4; Communications Systems 8; General Trade Knowledge and Theory 6.

title: WA Telecom Admin — Pretest B
description: 30-question NEC 2023 book-reference pretest. Distribution: Introduction 2; General Requirements 3; Grounding and Bonding 3; Wiring Methods 3; Hazardous Locations 1; Special Conditions 4; Communications Systems 8; General Trade Knowledge and Theory 6. Questions differ from Pretest A.

title: RCW 19.28 — Electricians & Electrical Installations
description: Washington State law governing electrical contractor licensing, electrician certification, inspections, and enforcement. 30 questions.

title: WAC 296-46B — WA Electrical Safety Standards
description: Washington State electrical construction rules, NEC amendments, permits, licensing, exams, and enforcement under WAC 296-46B. 30 questions.

title: WA Telecom Admin — Pretest C
description: 30-question NEC 2023 book-reference pretest with a 2-hour time allowance. Distribution: Introduction 2; General Requirements 3; Grounding and Bonding 3; Wiring Methods 3; Hazardous Locations 1; Special Conditions 4; Communications Systems 8; General Trade Knowledge and Theory 6. Code-based answers are drawn directly from the 2023 NEC text. Questions differ from Pretest B.
